title: Apiary-site suitability for Apis cerana in Kavrepalanchowk, Nepal: code (WLC, WPM, TOPSIS) v1.0.0
description: Python package and scripts for a GIS multi-criteria apiary-suitability model with literature-pooled weights, tested with three aggregation models (WLC, weighted product, TOPSIS), an independent recomputation, unit tests and a verification script.
